svg.title: Reef Archer: a Tide unit card, cost 2, attack 1, toughness 2, ranged
svg.desc: A Tapstone card face. A painted scene of a hooded archer on a coral rock drawing a bow with an arrow of seawater, above breaking waves, with the unit's pixel-art sprite inset in the corner. Cost 2, attack 1, toughness 2, keyword Ranged. Card st1-006.
